I set down the same words because the same words were what he used.
The same words returned when the lamp failed, and the same words returned after it burned again.
I kept the same words in my notebook, though I could not decide whether they were evidence or habit.
At noon the glass showed grey.
At one the needle moved west.
At two the casing felt warm.
This comprehensive account provides a clear framework for understanding the observed transition.
It is important to note that the evidence highlights a broader pattern of transformation.
Overall, these observations demonstrate the significance of the process in a rapidly changing environment.
